snippet.title: Onyx: The Dark Grip – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Onyx: The Dark Grip is coming exclusively to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027!

Survive as a vessel, intervene as a god. You play as the mysterious Entity, guiding the actions of a lone traveler who has arrived in the desolate ghost town. Use your powers to manipulate the environment and prevent your puppet from descending into the depths of madness.

#NintendoDirect #OnyxTheDarkGrip

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
